pages.text: Prepare farmland before selecting Farm. The command surveys loaded plots around the slime’s current position. The registered list stays fixed afterward. To include new plots, select Wait, then Farm. Stock suitable seeds or produce in the bag.

The farmer harvests mature crops and replants the same crop from its bag. Registered soil can be tilled back after reverting to supported dirt. Air, stone, or other non-soil removes a plot; Wait, then Farm registers it again.
Check the hoe, seeds, planting space, stamina, and cargo capacity when work stops. Releasing away from the farm center block clears old plots and waits for a new Farm order.
